pages.text: Cores are the crafting parts that set the tier of almost everything in the mod. There are four, from lowest to highest:$(li)$(item)Draconium Core$()$(li)$(item)Wyvern Core$()$(li)$(item)Draconic Core$() (made from Awakened Draconium)$(li)$(item)Chaotic Core$()$(br2)Items that hold energy also need an $(item)Energy Controller$(): Wyvern, Draconic or Chaotic.
Four Draconium Cores, Draconium ingots and a Nether Star.
Any of the four cores can also turn a vanilla spawner into a $(l:machines/stabilized_spawner)Stabilized Spawner$(/l).
The basic core: Draconium, gold and a diamond. Needed for the Fusion Crafting Core and most early machines.

pages.title: Higher tiers
pages.text: The $(item)Draconic Core$() needs Wyvern injectors and $(l:getting_started/awakened_draconium)Awakened Draconium$(/l).$(br2)The $(item)Chaotic Core$() needs Draconic injectors and $(item)Large Chaos Fragments$(), which come from the $(l:endgame/chaos_guardian)Chaos Guardian$(/l).
Wyvern Energy Controller: Draconium, Redstone blocks and a Draconium Core.
Draconic Energy Controller: four Wyvern Energy Controllers and Awakened Draconium around a Wyvern Core.
Chaotic Energy Controller: Draconic Energy Controllers, a Draconic Core and Medium Chaos Fragments.
